blocking: pair keys (3 rarest core-name tokens, 3 rarest address tokens, first house number; all pairs) + compact name + 8-char compact prefix; per-country; df<=1000; IDF-sum score; union of top-100 combined, top-20 name-channel, top-20 address-channel
normalization: NFKD+strip accents, lowercase, non-alnum->space; legal-form/honorific stoplist; learned Indic->Latin word dictionary (folds 0-7) + Unidecode fallback; address abbreviation/region map, leading zeros stripped
model: XGBoost hist n_estimators=1500 max_depth=10 lr=0.05 subsample=0.8 colsample=0.8 min_child_weight=5
training: 120K S1 from folds 0-7 (2x60K), hard-negative sampling (keep y=1, c_tsort>=60, a_tset>=60, brank<=10, +20% rest)
singleton_logic: empty list when no candidate p>=threshold
validation: 50K S1 fold 9, full train S2/S3 pool, macro F0.5 per S1
